c74object.name: evi_clip_hardsoft
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased clipping algorithms for your audio
c74object.description:
evi_clip_hardsoft is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_clip_hardsoft.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_clip.genexpr
evi_clip_hardsoft is also available in MSP as: evi.clip~.
A collection of four anti-aliased clipping algorithms: hard clip, soft clip, diode clip, asymmetric clip. Hard and soft are better anti-aliased and can take higher input gain before aliasing than the diode and asymmetric clippers. To be used whenever clamping of audio is required, evi.clip~ should do a good job of protecting your precious audio.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: In that must be treated nicely. Any audio input.

attribute.name: clip
attribute.description: Select the clipping function used. 0=hard (default), 1=soft, 2=diode, 3=asymmetric. 'Hard' is the equivalent of [clip~ -1. 1], 'soft' is the equivalent of [tanh~], 'diode' is a static model of a 12AX7, 'aymmetric' is a static version of Laurent de Soras' 'Gloubi Boulga'.

attribute.name: oversampling
attribute.description: Regardless of this setting, hard and soft clippers are 2nd order antiderivatives and thus already have excellent behaviour with @oversampling=0. Oversampling=1 is 2x oversampling, oversampling=2 is 4x oversampling.
